changelog:
Beatra AI Voice Studio 0.2.5

- Added explicit routing for podcast narration and improved route splitting at first entrance point.
- Now clarifies that this package handles voice selection and scenarios not covered by focused packages.
- Updated package documentation to reflect new routing options and clarify scope.
- Removed deprecated file (skill-card.md).
- Minor internal script and manifest adjustments for consistency and maintenance.
summary: Use Beatra AI Voice Studio as an AI voice generator, text-to-speech workspace, and AI voiceover generator. Choose from the current voice library, turn scripts into ready-to-edit AI narration and voiceover, or create and reuse a custom brand voice through voice cloning. It supports short-video voiceover, script-to-voiceover, course narration, ordered audiobook narration, supplied multilingual text to speech, Cantonese text to speech, and recurring brand audio, with current price estimates, clear output planning, and delivery organized by chapter, language, and use case.
